title: Miscellaneous data, finance, implementation - independent first pass

currency_conventions.deflator: ONS CPI all items 2015=100 (CDID D7BT), annual means

claims.meaning: Reporting currency and price year of every compared scheme
claims.value_or_rule: Report in GBP at real 2026 prices; deflate each nominal year by CPI(2026)/CPI(year) using annual-mean indices before discounting
claims.scope: all four schemes A0/A1/B0/B1 and every comparator
claims.recommended_baseline: GBP, real 2026, CPI deflator
claims.sensitivity_range: CPI vs GDP deflator unresolved; CPI substitution disclosed

claims.meaning: CPI all-items index used for deflation (2015=100, annual means)
claims.scope: UK all-items consumer prices, monthly series aggregated to annual means
claims.recommended_baseline: use annual-mean index for deflation; 2020->2026 factor 1.305951, 2025->2026 factor 1.026419

claims.meaning: EUR to GBP conversion of euro-denominated equipment costs

value_or_rule.rule: convert at the ECB annual mean for the source's own price year; if the price year is unknown use the 2026 mean and flag the uncertainty

claims.scope: euro-area reference rates published by the ECB, daily, averaged by calendar year
claims.recommended_baseline: 0.86097 GBP/EUR (2026 mean) for baseline; 0.83358 spot as lower sensitivity

claims.meaning: Brief battery cost EUR 0.288m per MWh of energy capacity converted to GBP
claims.unit: GBP per MWh (energy capacity) and GBP per MW (2-hour power capacity)
claims.scope: installed battery energy capacity, brief reference value; not a researched market price
claims.recommended_baseline: GBP 0.248m per MWh, i.e. GBP 0.496m per MW of 2-hour battery
claims.sensitivity_range: GBP 240.1k-256.2k per MWh from FX alone; source price year and R2 alternatives dominate

claims.meaning: Discount rate used for NPV / net benefit
claims.value_or_rule: real discount rate; report every headline result at 3.0%, 7.0% and 10.0% real with 7.0% as the team central case; the rate is a declared team decision, not an observed market rate
claims.scope: private consortium appraisal over a 15-year horizon
claims.recommended_baseline: 7.0% real central, labelled as an assumption
claims.sensitivity_range: 3.0% (Green Book social rate) to 10.0% real

claims.meaning: Scope limit of HM Treasury discounting guidance
claims.value_or_rule: The Green Book STPR is a social time-preference rate for appraising public policies in social cost-benefit terms (2026 edition: 3.00% real years 1-30, 2.50% years 31-75, 2.25% from year 76; the 2026 review terms of reference still state 3.5% for years 1-30). A social discount rate does not identify a private investor's cost of capital; debt/equity mix, tax and market risk are not covered by the guidance read here.
claims.scope: public-sector appraisal guidance, not private project finance
claims.evidence_strength: primary_guidance_read; two official pages conflict on the current rate
claims.recommended_baseline: cite the guidance for the social lower bound only; state explicitly that the client's cost of capital is unknown
claims.sensitivity_range: 3.0% vs 3.5% discrepancy between two GOV.UK pages accessed the same day

claims.meaning: Evaluation horizon and cash-flow timing
claims.value_or_rule: 15-year horizon; investment at t=0 undiscounted; real operating cash flows in years 1..15; sensitivity at 10 and 20 years
claims.scope: battery and electrolyser additions compared with zero-investment cases
claims.recommended_baseline: 15 years
claims.sensitivity_range: 10 to 20 years; at 20 years a battery replacement or residual must be added

claims.meaning: Discount factors and annuity factors by rate and year
claims.scope: real-terms discounting; DF(t)=1/(1+r)^t, annuity=(1-(1+r)^-n)/r
claims.recommended_baseline: use the tabulated factors; do not mix a nominal rate with real cash flows
claims.sensitivity_range: see rates column

claims.meaning: Capital recovery (annualisation) of upfront CAPEX
claims.value_or_rule: annual equivalent = CAPEX * CRF(r,n), CRF(r,n)=r/(1-(1+r)^-n); 2-hour battery at GBP 495,919/MW gives about GBP 41.5k/MW-yr at 3.0%, GBP 54.4k/MW-yr at 7.0%, GBP 65.2k/MW-yr at 10.0% over 15 years
claims.scope: annual-equivalent reporting and levelised cost comparisons
claims.recommended_baseline: either annualise CAPEX or discount the full CAPEX once, never both

claims.meaning: Replacement and residual-value accounting
claims.value_or_rule: charge a replacement as a discounted cash flow in its year, or inside an annual sinking-fund charge, never both; residual value default 0, otherwise CAPEX * remaining_life/life discounted to the horizon end; apply identical rules to every scheme
claims.scope: 15-year base horizon; 20-year sensitivity triggers one battery replacement; electrolyser stack replacement is a separate line
claims.recommended_baseline: residual 0; one battery replacement only if horizon exceeds assumed 15-year life; stack replacement separate
claims.sensitivity_range: residual 0 to straight-line; stack life from R3 not obtained here

claims.meaning: Payback and ROI definitions
claims.value_or_rule: simple payback = CAPEX / mean annual real net cash flow (undiscounted); discounted payback = first year with cumulative discounted net cash flow >= 0; ROI = NPV/CAPEX; report all three against low/central/high price years
claims.scope: incremental comparison of A1 vs A0 and B1 vs B0
claims.recommended_baseline: report both payback definitions plus NPV and ROI
claims.sensitivity_range: annual mean price ranged 16.09 (2020) to 95.38 (2022) GBP/MWh, so payback must be shown per price regime

claims.meaning: Bridge from the 6.59-year historical sample to a lifetime NPV
claims.value_or_rule: annual average profit = total profit over the 2,406 common dates / 6.587 years; lifetime PV = annual average * annuity factor (15 yr: 11.938 at 3.0%, 9.108 at 7.0%, 7.606 at 10.0%); also report the no-extrapolation in-sample net profit
claims.recommended_baseline: report both the extrapolated lifetime PV and the in-sample profit
claims.sensitivity_range: annuity factor 15-20 years; representativeness of 2020-2026 unproven

claims.meaning: Daily power to daily energy conversion
claims.value_or_rule: E_MWh(day) = MW(day) * 24; evidence: price columns satisfy per_MW_day = 24 * per_MWh on all 2,422 rows (max relative deviation 1.5e-16) and annual totals are national-scale
claims.scope: all four energy series; generation = total_MW + wind_farm_MW
claims.recommended_baseline: 24 h per calendar day, fixed across all schemes and recorded in the run manifest
claims.sensitivity_range: assumption cannot be verified from daily data; energy and revenue scale linearly with the assumed hours while CAPEX does not

claims.meaning: Which price column to use
claims.value_or_rule: use avg_price_GBP_per_MWh as revenue per MWh sold; the avg_price_GBP_per_MW_day column is a derived check (24x)
claims.scope: market-index revenue; not a verified export tariff or offtake contract
claims.source_ref: audit_results.json checks.price_column_identity; baseline BL-02/BL-07; R1 for market rules
claims.recommended_baseline: avg_price_GBP_per_MWh, negative values retained
claims.sensitivity_range: R1 may supply alternative offtake/tariff scenarios

claims.meaning: Negative and extreme prices
claims.value_or_rule: keep all 9 negative daily prices (min -8.465 GBP/MWh on 2024-01-02) and the 32 robust-z>6 price days; 1 zero-price day; max 333.825 GBP/MWh on 2021-09-09
claims.scope: market index over 2,422 dates
claims.recommended_baseline: retain; negative prices mean selling reduces revenue and B-regime supply priority still binds
claims.sensitivity_range: tail-excluded scenario is an explicit ablation tag, not ordinary cleaning

claims.meaning: Common-date intersection used for modelling
claims.scope: five supplied files
claims.recommended_baseline: model the intersection; disclose 1.9% coverage loss
claims.sensitivity_range: per-file extra dates: demand +30, generation +1, price 16 mismatched, wind +31 (incl. 2026-09-18)

claims.meaning: Continuity of the common-date record
claims.value_or_rule: 28 calendar-continuous segments, 27 gaps of 1-4 days; longest segment 2022-09-24..2026-09-17 (1,455 days)
claims.scope: 2,406 common dates
claims.recommended_baseline: never join dates across a gap; restart battery SOC at the minimum buffer at each segment start; use the 1,455-day segment for multi-day storage behaviour
claims.sensitivity_range: segment-level exclusion of short segments is an optional ablation

claims.meaning: Reporting-completeness artefact: dates with all dispatchable fuels exactly zero
claims.value_or_rule: 107 dates have 0 MW for nuclear, gas, coal, oil, biomass, hydro, pumped storage and other while wind and solar are populated; blocks 2022-12-01..2023-01-11 (42 d), 2023-04-24..05-03 (10), 2024-02-08..02-19 (12), 2025-03-09..03-12 and 2025-03-22..03-31 (14), 2026-07-10..2026-08-03 (25); 62 of them also fall below 10,000 MW total generation
claims.scope: daily_generation_by_fuel.csv / daily_generation_total.csv
claims.evidence_strength: computed_from_primary_files; physical impossibility is an inference
claims.recommended_baseline: keep in the baseline (BL-11) but run every headline result a second time excluding these dates plus the 2022-08-02 demand outlier (108 dates)
claims.sensitivity_range: exclusion lowers computed deficit from 160.30 to 111.41 TWh while surplus moves 40.63 to 40.01 TWh

claims.meaning: Single implausible demand observation
claims.value_or_rule: 2022-08-02 demand = 636 MW against next-lowest 19,241 MW and median 27,472 MW; only demand date with robust z>6; it creates the largest single surplus day (616 GWh)
claims.scope: daily_demand.csv
claims.evidence_strength: computed_from_primary_file; error status is an inference
claims.recommended_baseline: retain in baseline, exclude in SA-DQ; never silently overwrite
claims.sensitivity_range: single-day effect on totals is small except for peak-surplus reporting

claims.meaning: Wind-farm series saturation and zeros
claims.value_or_rule: exactly 1,125.0 MW on 29 dates (apparent capacity cap / clipping); exactly 0 MW on 10 dates
claims.scope: wind_farm_generation.csv (2,453 dates)
claims.recommended_baseline: retain; note that clipped days understate achievable capture and that zero-output days are a genuine simulation feature
claims.sensitivity_range: cap-scaling scenario is an optional ablation

claims.meaning: Fuel-level table reconciles exactly to the total file
claims.value_or_rule: 11 rows per date for all 2,422 dates; per-date sum equals total_MW with maximum absolute difference 0 MW; 0 duplicate (date, psrType) pairs
claims.scope: daily_generation_by_fuel.csv vs daily_generation_total.csv
claims.recommended_baseline: use total_MW and never add the fuel rows again (BL-02)
claims.sensitivity_range: none needed

claims.meaning: Chronological fit/validation/test split
claims.scope: Tier 1 day-independent allocation; multi-day SOC experiments use the continuous 2022-09-24..2026-09-17 block
claims.recommended_baseline: use this split; capacity chosen on fit only; single validation pass; test reported once
claims.sensitivity_range: if validation is consulted more than once the test window must be disclosed as influenced

claims.meaning: Capacity selection rule fixed in advance
claims.value_or_rule: choose the fit-window NPV-maximising capacity; treat a 5% profit plateau as a tie and choose the smaller capacity
claims.scope: A1 and B1 design
claims.recommended_baseline: adopt; prevents post-hoc selection on held-out profit
claims.sensitivity_range: plateau width 0-10%

claims.meaning: Validation pack required before any number is reported
claims.value_or_rule: per-day energy balance residual <= 1e-6 of daily energy; recomputed money balance within GBP 1 or 1e-9 relative; SOC within 20-80% of installed energy; charge/discharge energy <= power*24; electrolyser off or 20-100% of capacity; H2 kg = MWh/55.9*1000; zero-investment cases solve; LP relaxation bounds the MILP
claims.scope: every solved scenario, checked from an exported solution rather than from the model object
claims.recommended_baseline: adopt as a release gate
claims.sensitivity_range: n/a

claims.meaning: Solver status, gap and runtime reporting
claims.value_or_rule: report status, objective, MIP gap, nodes, wall-clock, Xpress version and input hashes; accept optimal or relative gap <= 1e-4, otherwise report a bound; measure and record the runtime pilot for the full 2,406-day model
claims.scope: every scenario in the four-way comparison
claims.source_ref: baseline BL-14; lecture guidance on 5 min-1 h working envelope
claims.recommended_baseline: adopt; fix solver threads for determinism
claims.sensitivity_range: gap tolerance 1e-3 to 1e-6
